### T-354 — The FilteredServer snapshot depends on stream timing

> _2026-10-16 · tools/blong-log · done_

The `LogViewer` `FilteredServer` story streams a log entry on a `setInterval` (up to 50 entries) and
`.storybook/test-runner.cjs` screenshots in `postVisit` without waiting for that stream to settle,
so the committed image snapshot depends on how many ticks fired before the shot: it passed in 771ms
on one run and failed at 0.527% differing pixels (4857 pixels) in 3310ms on the next. Freeze the
stream for the shot — stop the interval, or drive the count from a fixed seed — rather than widening
the snapshot threshold, which would hide a real render change.

FilteredServer streams ten bounded messages and the runner waits eight seconds before its shot; the
regenerated baseline shows the settled table and reproduced on a second run.
